text:
Nora: Heads-up — Harborly onboarding monitor shows a short uptime dip + increased median latency during their peak test window. Customer flagged before renewal.
ops-bot: Alert: uptime_drop detected | account=harborly | downtime=00:02:20 | window=2026-03-19T16:42:00Z/2026-03-19T16:45:00Z
Priya: Uptime SLO is 99.95% monthly. Two-minute blip could push them into credit territory depending on how we round windows. Dan, any infra events?
Dan: No global infra incidents. I see a spike in eviction rate on the KV cache for their VPC shard around 16:42Z. Likely caused by a model warm-up storm from their onboarding load test.
Olivia: They're running heavy batching with batch_size=32 as part of their test harness. We recommended 8-16 in onboarding docs.
Nora: They want us to confirm whether this qualifies for SLA credits and have a one-slide explanation for renewal meeting tomorrow.
legal-bot: Per TOS section 4.2, credits apply if verified breach occurs within billing window and is not caused by customer misconfig. Evidence bundle required.
Priya: Ok — steps: 1) pull minute-level uptime + latency histograms for 16:30-17:00Z, 2) snapshot route configs, 3) collect kernel/runtime shas and autoscaler events, 4) produce credit estimate and short comms. Who owns?
Dan: I'll pull metrics + eviction logs. Command I ran: 
```
redwood-cli metrics get --account harborly --metrics uptime,latency_50p,latency_95p,cache_evictions --range "2026-03-19T16:30:00Z/2026-03-19T17:00:00Z" --granularity 1m > harborly-window.ndjson
```
Dan: Also saving node events: `/var/log/redwood/node-events-20260319.log` filtered by shard-id.
Olivia: I'll capture the route config and batch settings: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood/api/v1/accounts/harborly/routes > harborly-routes.json
```
Nora: Please include a short analysis of whether this was self-inflicted by the customer's test harness. If so, that affects credit eligibility.
Priya: Noted. Dan, attach eviction-rate timeseries + autoscaler logs — we need to show correlation.
Dan: Uploaded metrics & logs to evidence: s3://redwood-evidence/harborly/3521004321-evidence.tar.gz (sha256: b47f0c8e7a9b2c2d)
ops-bot: Evidence bundle created and ticketed as CS-5519.
Olivia: Quick analysis: median latency increased from 70ms -> 210ms at 16:42Z; 95p hit 880ms for two minutes. Uptime shows a short TCP-retry period causing 2m of failed requests. Cache evictions spiked from 2/min -> 240/min.
Priya: Given the telemetry, this looks like an operational degradation on our side triggered by large batch warm-ups. We'll propose remediation and an immediate recommendation: lower default batch to 12 for their onboarding shard and enable a staggered warm-up.
Nora: Credit estimate: rough calc gives ~1.1% invoice credit for March window (using prorated minutes method). Olivia, can you put that in a 1-paragraph customer-facing note? Keep it simple: what happened, our remediation, expected credit, next steps.
Olivia: Drafting now, will post here in 20m. Sample phrasing: 
"Between 16:42Z-16:44Z on 2026-03-19 we observed an operational degradation caused by a cache eviction storm correlated with very large batched requests from your onboarding load test. Impact: short increase in tail latency and ~2 minutes of failed requests. Remediation: lowered batch defaults for your shard, warming policy enabled. Estimated invoice credit: ~1.1%."
Nora: Also add a sentence about follow-up: we'll run a joint test with reduced batching and share a replay of the metrics.
legal-bot: Keep the raw evidence and a signed memo of steps taken in case of dispute.
Dan: Saved MD5 and SHA256 checksums in the ticket.
ops-bot: Config change scheduled: set batch_size default to 12 for account=harborly at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z with 30m automatic rollback if error.
Priya: I'll prepare the renewal meeting slide deck (1 slide) with the 3 bullets: incident, impact, compensation + next steps. Will attach to CS-5519.
Nora: Assignments: Dan (evidence + telemetry), Olivia (customer note + slide language), Priya (renewal slide + credit calc), legal-bot (TOS check). Follow-up here once customer note is posted.
Olivia: Posted draft note to CS-5519 and linked evidence. https://console.redwood/ops/cs-5519/notes
Nora: Thanks team. If customer pushes back on root cause, escalate to SRE for a post-incident review.
Priya: Will schedule a 30m postmortem if needed.
Dan: Done: CS-5519 contains artifacts and a short timeline.
Nora: Thread closed after customer update; will reopen if renewal call needs escalation. :white_check_mark:
